The following papers got accepted for publication on the International Conference on Computational Science and Its Applications (ICCSA 2022):

- Adrian Jobst, Daniel Atzberger, Tim Cech, Willy Scheibel, Matthias Trapp, and Jürgen Döllner: "Efficient GitHub Crawling using the GraphQL API"

- Andreas Fricke, Jürgen Döllner, and Hartmut Asche: "A Virtual 3D City Model for Urban Planning and Decision-Making - The East Jerusalem Case"

- Ole Wegen, Jürgen Döllner, and Rico Richter: "Concepts and Challenges for 4D Point Clouds as a Foundation of Conscious, Smart City Systems"

- Salvador Merino Cordoba, Francisco Guzmán Navarro, Javier Martínez del Castillo, Rafael Guzmán Sepúlveda, Juan De Dios Lara Fernández, and Jürgen Döllner: "A Conscious, Smart Site Model for a Solar-Water Energy System"

The conference takes place in Malaga, Spain from 4 to 7 of July. For more information, please refer to https://iccsa.org/.
